name: Daniel Meier Endler
headline: Lead Deployment Strategist @ Parloa | Driving Enterprise AI Transformation with Meaningful Customer Relationships
summary:
I am a Product & Technology leader with 10+ years of experience scaling companies from early-stage startups to IPO preparation. My expertise spans fintech, logistics, and climate tech, with leadership roles in B2C (N26, Delivery Hero) and B2B (Remagine, Resourcify, Deel).

I specialize in product-led growth, international expansion, compliance, and operational excellence, building and scaling cross-functional teams that drive business impact. At Deel, I lead the Platform & Fintech verticals, overseeing global payments, financial products, and infrastructure while preparing the company for IPO. Previously, at N26, I helped shape Europe’s first cloud-native bank, leading core banking, compliance, UX, and AI-driven credit models.

I am passionate about solving complex problems at scale, from launching new financial ecosystems to optimizing regulatory frameworks. My approach is rooted in data-driven decision-making, customer-centricity, and team empowerment to build products that are not only scalable but also drive meaningful value.

positions.title: Lead Deployment Strategist
positions.description:
Parloa is a conversational AI platform that helps enterprises deliver smarter, more human-like customer interactions across voice and digital channels.

As part of the Product Deployment Group, my role is to bridge product and go-to-market:
 - Designing strategies to bring new features and solutions to customers successfully
 - Partnering with Product, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure adoption and measurable impact
 - Defining how product deployment can become a core growth driver for Parloa

- Leading Platform & Fintech verticals, managing 17 teams and influencing over 80 designers, engineers, and product managers.

positions.title: VP Product & Engineering
positions.description:
Enabling a Zero-Waste Future for Businesses

Being part of the management team of the company, I am leading the efforts towards a product lead company.
I am responsible for the product strategy, defining KPIs, hiring, organizational design and support our key strategic clients.

company.name: Parloa
company.tagline: Amplify your customer service experience with an AI agent management platform.
company.description: Parloa is a leading global AI company with a vision to make every customer interaction as easy as talking to a friend. We amplify the customer service experience with our AI Agent Management Platform. This enterprise-grade platform automates contact centers by leveraging the full power of generative AI safely & reliably in the context of consumer interactions. It combines highly-skilled personal AI agents that engage in natural and unique conversations with every customer, with AI assistance for human agents when they get on the line. Global brands trust Parloa to connect with their customers, ensuring they feel heard through exceptional experiences that increase satisfaction, encourage sales, and build loyalty. Parloa was founded in 2018 by Malte Kosub and Stefan Ostwald with offices in Berlin, Munich, and New York.
